definitions.rationale: This equation defines the public mathematical summary filterByPrefix as filterAcc initialized with an empty accumulator.
definitions.text: rule filterByPrefix(INPUT, PREFIX) => filterAcc(INPUT, PREFIX, nil)

definitions.rationale: This is the base recurrence defining filterAcc on an empty remaining input: the accumulated stable filter result is returned.
This simplification rule is the matching-head recurrence of filterAcc, defining the summary by appending the matching head and recurring on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule filterAcc(cons(S, REST), PREFIX, ACC) =>
    filterAcc(REST, PREFIX, appendOne(ACC, S))
    requires startsWith(S, PREFIX) ==Bool true [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This simplification rule is the nonmatching-head recurrence of filterAcc, defining the summary by recurring on the tail without changing the accumulator.
definitions.text:
rule filterAcc(cons(S, REST), PREFIX, ACC) =>
    filterAcc(REST, PREFIX, ACC)
    requires startsWith(S, PREFIX) ==Bool false [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This structural helper expands the named proof term loopBody into the exact translated statement list used as the loop body.
definitions.text:
rule loopBody() =>
    If(Call(Attribute(Name("string"), "startswith"), Name("prefix")),
       Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), Name("string"))) .Stmts,
       .Stmts) .Stmts

definitions.rationale: This structural helper expands the named proof term solutionProgram into the exact translated module whose execution is the subject of the end-to-end claim.
definitions.text:
rule solutionProgram() =>
    Module(
      ImportFrom("typing", "List", .Strings)
      FuncDef("filter_by_prefix", Params("strings", "prefix", .Strings),
        Assign(Name("result"), ListExpr())
        For(Name("string"), Name("strings"), loopBody())
        Return(Name("result"))))
